analyzed_vuln.description: Heap buffer overflow in VM is caused by malformed/truncated bytecode buffer produced by compiler finalization. In scope_finish(), irep->iseq is resized with codegen_realloc(s->iseq, sizeof(mrb_code)*s->pc + catchsize) but irep->ilen is set to s->pc (instruction count). mrb_code is wider than 1 byte, while VM instruction fetch in mrb_vm_exec treats iseq as a byte stream and reads past the 11-byte allocation for PoC. The root bug is incorrect iseq sizing/layout during codegen finalization, leading to out-of-bounds read at vm.c:1183.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Data flows from mruby_fuzzer (LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput -> mrb_load_string) into parser/codegen. The PoC source `3or l=3\nl+=12\n1` compiles into an irep whose finalized iseq allocation is too small/inconsistent with VM decode expectations. When mrb_top_run executes that irep, mrb_vm_exec decodes OP_LOADI32 and reads instruction bytes beyond the heap allocation boundary, triggering ASan heap-buffer-overflow.
